claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Azaperone is a butyrophenone dopamine receptor antagonist that at 2.5 uM likely causes cationic amphiphilic lysosomal stress and/or weak nonspecific cytotoxicity rather than DRD2/DRD3-mediated killing.
